coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass submitted for coordinator review; not exhaustive. Searches cover four January date spans (1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–31) with French/English plus Arabic, and targeted transport, education, health, students, employment, prices, and regional queries naming Tizi Ouzou, Béjaïa, Oran, Constantine, Annaba, Ouargla and southern wilayas. Retrospective/local outlet, APS, Amnesty and Human Rights Watch searches were run. One TSA article body was read under the exact-target release; it establishes a Jan 1–11 transport strike and negotiation but no public gathering or >=50 attendance. No qualifying event is coded. Tamazight coverage, archives, complete local press coverage and the uncaptured earlier Q004 output remain gaps; search results do not establish absence.
